title: Light in Room Nine  (九号房的灯光)

segments.t: 在九号房的走廊里，Graham用新买的黑色电工胶带卷缠好最后一个接头，同时Hannah扶着梯子，Caleb检查着墙上的开关面板。先完整听一遍这一幕。
Hand me the small brass screws from your pocket, Hannah.
One, two. Is the new copper wire connected all the way to the box?
Brand-new wire, new porcelain fuse, and zero old cloth left in the wall.
The brass switch plate sits straight and tight against the brick.
Step down clear of the ladder. Ready to test it properly, Hannah?
Should we call Arthur to flip the switch?
Not a chance. Your turn, Hannah, one clean click.
Here goes... click! Oh, look at that warm golden light!
The frosted glass shade spreads soft light across every windowpane!
Listen to the kitchen too: no pop, and the oven is still humming.
Room Nine officially has light after thirty dark years!
Wait, look at the shadow inside the open piano lid, Hannah!
现在我们来一步步回顾这一幕。
Hand me the small brass screws from your pocket, Hannah.
“把你口袋里的小黄铜螺丝递给我，Hannah。”请别人把随手可拿的东西递过来时，名词 hand 可用作动词，如
Hand me
，避免使用更冗长的表达。
One, two. Is the new copper wire connected all the way to the box?
“一、二。新的铜线一直连到配电箱了吗？”要确认电线是否一路畅通无断点，这里再次用到了
all the way to the box?
，此处指的是保险丝盒。
Brand-new wire, new porcelain fuse, and zero old cloth left in the wall.
“全新的电线、全新的陶瓷保险丝，墙上一点旧布线都没留。”要强调某物全新未用过，可以在 new 前加上 brand，如
Brand-new wire,
，而放在名词后面的 left 表示“剩余的、留下来的”。
The brass switch plate sits straight and tight against the brick.
“黄铜开关面板贴在砖墙上又正又稳。”要形象地描述某个部件如何贴合到位，动词 sit 非常生动：
sits straight and tight
，仿佛面板稳稳地靠在墙上一般。
Step down clear of the ladder. Ready to test it properly, Hannah?
“下来并远离梯子。准备好正式测试了吗，Hannah？”在车间或梯子旁为了安全起见，
clear of the ladder.
用于提醒大家把周围空间让出来。
Should we call Arthur to flip the switch?
“我们要不要叫Arthur来拨一下开关？”快速拨上或拨下电灯开关小拨杆的动作，正好可以用这个动词来表达：
flip the switch?
，因为 flip 形容的就是干脆利落的一拨。
Not a chance. Your turn, Hannah, one clean click.
“想都别想。轮到你了，Hannah，干脆利落地按一下。”要用带点幽默的干脆语气否决一个危险的想法，
Not a chance.
字面意思就相当于“一点机会都没有”。
Here goes... click! Oh, look at that warm golden light!
“来了……咔哒！哦，快看那温暖的金色灯光！”在按下按钮或动手试某件事前的那一刻，人们脱口而出的固定表达是
Here goes...
，用的是第三人称单数形式。
The frosted glass shade spreads soft light across every windowpane!
“磨砂玻璃灯罩把柔和的灯光洒满每一块窗玻璃！”那种把灯光散射得像蒙了一层霜似的哑光玻璃叫做
frosted glass shade
，词源来自 frost（霜）。
Listen to the kitchen too: no pop, and the oven is still humming.
“也听听厨房那边：没有一点噼啪杂音，烤箱还在稳稳嗡嗡作响。”发动机或电器运转时发出的低沉连续声响可以用这个词来描述：
is still humming.
，也就是我们平时用来指闭着嘴哼唱的动词 hum。
Room Nine officially has light after thirty dark years!
“荒废黑暗了三十年后，九号房终于正式通电亮灯了！”下面这句里紧放在动词前面的副词
officially has light
给整个场面增添了一种庄重的启用仪式感。
Wait, look at the shadow inside the open piano lid, Hannah!
“等等，看打开的钢琴盖里面的影子，Hannah！”这串名词组合
open piano lid,
直接把我们引向下一幕的发现。让我们再从头到尾完整听一遍这一幕。
Hand me the small brass screws from your pocket, Hannah.
One, two. Is the new copper wire connected all the way to the box?
Brand-new wire, new porcelain fuse, and zero old cloth left in the wall.
The brass switch plate sits straight and tight against the brick.
Step down clear of the ladder. Ready to test it properly, Hannah?
Should we call Arthur to flip the switch?
Not a chance. Your turn, Hannah, one clean click.
Here goes... click! Oh, look at that warm golden light!
The frosted glass shade spreads soft light across every windowpane!
Listen to the kitchen too: no pop, and the oven is still humming.
Room Nine officially has light after thirty dark years!
Wait, look at the shadow inside the open piano lid, Hannah!
磨砂玻璃吸顶灯洒下金色的光芒，没有烧断一根保险丝；而在明亮的灯光下，钢琴盖底下突然显出一道影子。我们马上接着听下一幕。
See you soon!
